anchors.exact_quote: On engines equipped with 1-string cooling water system, the LT system is vented via the HT system. This means that both systems are connected to the same expansion tank. On engines equipped with 2-string cooling water system, separate expansion tanks for the LT system and HT system must be installed. This to accommodate for changes of volume due to varying temperatures and possible leakage in the LT system and/or the HT system.
anchors.candidate_span: 采用单回路冷却水系统的发动机，LT系统通过HT系统排气，两系统连接至同一膨胀水箱；采用双回路冷却水系统的发动机，LT系统与HT系统必须设置各自独立的膨胀水箱，以适应温度变化引起的体积变化以及LT和/或HT系统的可能泄漏。
